title: Detailed toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="frontFace" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF5A5A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#CC2222"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="topFace" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF8888"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF4444"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sideFace" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B01818"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8A1010"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="studTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFAAAA"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF5555"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="studSide" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#DD3333"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#AA2020"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="letterGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFF88"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFDD00"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Top face -->
  <polygon points="18,30 82,30 70,12 30,12" fill="url(#topFace)"/>

  <!-- Front face -->
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="64" height="56" rx="3" ry="3" fill="url(#frontFace)"/>
  
  <!-- Side face (right) -->
  <polygon points="82,30 70,12 70,68 82,86" fill="url(#sideFace)"/>

  <!-- Front face edge highlights -->
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="64" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FF7777" opacity="0.6"/>
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="4" height="56" rx="2" fill="#FF7777" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Edge between front and side -->
  <line x1="82" y1="30" x2="82" y2="86" stroke="#FF8866" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Edge between top and front -->
  <line x1="18" y1="30" x2="82" y2="30" stroke="#FFAA88" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Top face studs (4 studs in 2x2) -->
  <!-- Stud 1 top-left -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="20" rx="9" ry="5" fill="url(#studTop)"/>
  <rect x="26" y="20" width="18" height="4" fill="url(#studSide)"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="24" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#BB2222"/>
  
  <!-- Stud 2 top-right -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="20" rx="9" ry="5" fill="url(#studTop)"/>
  <rect x="56" y="20" width="18" height="4" fill="url(#studSide)"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="24" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#BB2222"/>

  <!-- Stud 3 bottom-left -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="27" rx="9" ry="4.5" fill="url(#studTop)"/>
  <rect x="26" y="27" width="18" height="3.5" fill="url(#studSide)"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="30.5" rx="9" ry="3.5" fill="#BB2222"/>

  <!-- Stud 4 bottom-right -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="27" rx="9" ry="4.5" fill="url(#studTop)"/>
  <rect x="56" y="27" width="18" height="3.5" fill="url(#studSide)"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="30.5" rx="9" ry="3.5" fill="#BB2222"/>

  <!-- Stud highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="18.5" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#FFCCCC" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="18.5" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#FFCCCC" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Letter "A" on front face -->
  <!-- A shape made of thick yellow lines -->
  <g stroke="url(#letterGrad)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <!-- Left leg -->
    <line x1="38" y1="76" x2="50" y2="42"/>
    <!-- Right leg -->
    <line x1="62" y1="76" x2="50" y2="42"/>
    <!-- Crossbar -->
    <line x1="43" y1="65" x2="57" y2="65"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Letter highlight glow -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFAA" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.4">
    <line x1="39" y1="74" x2="50" y2="43"/>
    <line x1="61" y1="74" x2="50" y2="43"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="64" x2="56" y2="64"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Subtle front face shading (bottom darker) -->
  <rect x="18" y="76" width="64" height="10" rx="2" fill="#AA1515" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Side face subtle detail -->
  <rect x="83" y="45" width="8" height="30" fill="#991515" opacity="0.2"/>
</svg>
